The API SLA risk calculator implementation passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust logic for weighted risk assessment.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across all trials with zero exceptions recorded. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.318 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the current logic is verified, future iterations should ensure the weighting constants remain configurable to avoid hardcoding assumptions that might fail under different SLA threshold requirements.
